none: PAS SWYOR-3A74E3: Roman coin; denarius of Trajan
contea di ritrovamento: Doncaster (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ COS V P P S P Q R OPTIMO PRINC

A Roman silver coin: a denarius of Trajan dating from AD 98 - 117 (Reece period 5). The reverse legend reads COS V P P S P Q R OPTIMO PRINC; the reverse type depicts Fortuna standing, facing left, holding rudder and cornucopia with the forepart of a ship to the left of her feet. The mint is Rome. Compare Sear, volume 2, number 3125. The coin is 18.3mm in diameter and 2.6mm thick. It weighs 2.97gm
